# mock.shop starter

> A Hydrogen storefront (Shopify's React Router template, Hydrogen 2026.10) pre-wired to mock.shop, Shopify's auth-free Storefront API with 100+ fictional stores. Clone it, run `npm install` and `npm run dev`, and you are browsing a store. Switch stores with one environment variable; switch to a real Shopify store when you are ready.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): quickstart, the store directory, and how to pick a store
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what a coding agent needs to know before editing this project
- [.env.example](.env.example): `PUBLIC_STORE_DOMAIN` selects a store; leave `PRIVATE_STOREFRONT_API_TOKEN` empty for mock.shop
- Hydrogen agent skills: `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`, matched to the installed Hydrogen version

## mock.shop

- [Store directory](https://mock.shop/llms.txt): every store, what it sells, and its API URL
- [About mock.shop](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/headless/mock-shop): the guide on shopify.dev
- Storefront API endpoint per store: `POST https://<store>.mock.shop/api` with a JSON body; no access token
- Per-store catalog: `https://<store>.mock.shop/llms.txt`

## Hydrogen

- [Hydrogen documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/hydrogen)
- [Storefront API reference](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront)
- [Deploy to Oxygen](https://shopify.dev/docs/storefronts/hydrogen/deploy/oxygen): where this template deploys
- [Shopify AI Toolkit](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/ai-toolkit): skills and instructions for Shopify work in coding agents

## Limits

- Carts work; checkout is mocked (no payment is taken and no order is placed); the Customer Account API is not available, so `/account` explains what is missing.
- All products, prices, and inventory are fictional.
